_note: Retell custom-function definitions. In the Retell dashboard, add each as a Custom Function with the given name, description, URL (https://YOUR-DEPLOYMENT/api/tools/...), and JSON parameters below. speak_during_execution keeps latency invisible: the agent says a filler line while the tool runs.

tools.name: lookup_patient
tools.description: Look up a caller by phone number to greet returning patients and see their upcoming appointments. Call this once you have the caller's phone number.

phone.description: Caller's phone number in E.164, e.g. +919812345678

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Find open appointment slots. Provide a department OR a doctor name OR a symptom (the tool routes symptoms to the right department). Optionally a date_hint (today, tomorrow, this week, a weekday) and type (new, followup, tele). Returns the soonest slots with slot_id, doctor, and a speakable time.

doctor.description: Doctor's name if the caller asked for someone specific

symptom.description: What the caller said is wrong, e.g. 'knee pain' — used to route to a department

date_hint.description: today | tomorrow | this week | a weekday like 'Friday'

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a specific slot for the caller. Use a slot_id returned by check_availability. Confirm the doctor, date, and time with the caller BEFORE calling this.

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move an existing appointment to a new slot. Get the appointment_id from lookup_patient and a new_slot_id from check_availability.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel an existing appointment. Get the appointment_id from lookup_patient. Confirm with the caller before cancelling.
